name: print-social-love-match-tic-tac-toe-hearts-with-product
title: Cream 'Style + Game = Love Match' post with a pink tic-tac-toe of hearts and one product cell
whatItIs: A cream post with a coral serif headline (second line italic) over a pink tic-tac-toe grid where eight cells hold brushy pink hearts and one holds a white round dish with a flower clip, and a small handle at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Sweet and playful; a familiar game turns a product into the winning move.
techniques: Use a well-known game grid as layout.
Fill cells with one repeated shape and one exception.
Set serif headline in coral with an italic line.

vocabulary.definition: A game board used as design structure.
One different item among repeated ones.
A heart with a rough painted edge.
The second headline line set in italic.
